faq.a: Each field validates against its base: a '2' in the binary field or a 'G' in hex shows an inline error and the other fields keep their last valid values.

whenNotToUse: It converts integers only — fractions and floating-point values need a different tool, and two's-complement/signed representations are not applied.
Hexadecimal output uses uppercase A–F without a 0x prefix; add prefixes yourself if your target format needs them.
